agent-chat.api: Your AI SDK route: anything that returns `toUIMessageStreamResponse()`.
agent-chat.assistant: Who's working, on the approval card and at the top of the run.
agent-chat.tools: The tools on your route, by name, and how each one reads.
agent-chat.starters: Offered while the thread is empty. The demo asks the first.
agent-chat.followUps: Offered under a finished answer; ones already asked drop out.

analytics.product: The product's name, in the sidebar, the chart and the feed.
analytics.onRangeChange: Called when a person changes the range.
analytics.onApprove: Called with the request a person approves.
analytics.onDeny: Called with the request a person denies.
analytics.onFixGap: Called when a person fixes a knowledge gap: drafts the doc or adds the rule it needs.
analytics.sidebar: Draw the product's sidebar. Turn it off to drop the screen into your own layout.
analytics.onNavigate: Called with a sidebar page a person presses; without it the sidebar is a picture.

announce.tag: The word in the tag, which rolls to `action` when you reach for it.
announce.dismissible: Show a close button. Pair it with `onDismiss` to remember the choice.
announce.linkAs: Your router's link, if it has one.

answer.phase: Where the answer is: thinking, streaming the reply, or done.
answer.thoughts: What it's thinking, a line at a time. The newest shows while it thinks.
answer.summary: One line that replaces the live thought once thinking ends.
answer.tools: Each search or read it ran, with what it found and how long it took.
answer.text: Markdown-lite: paragraphs, "- " and "1. " lists, a **bold** line as a heading, **bold**, `code`, [n] citations.
answer.sources: What it read. Citations in the text point at these by id.
answer.stats: Shown beside the actions when done, e.g. "6.1s · 4 sources".
answer.followUps: Questions to ask next, offered once the answer is done.
answer.onFollowUp: Called with the follow-up a person picks.
answer.onRegenerate: Called when a person asks for another answer.
answer.width: The answer's width. It's fixed, so the text wraps once and never re-flows as it streams.
answer.compact: Kept for older callers: sources always sit inline now, so there's no grid to leave out.
answer.tone: How loud the AI colour is while it works: the full spectrum, or the same motion in ink. Leave it out and it's loud the first time, then quiet for a while.

approval.requests: Waiting for a decision, oldest first. The first is shown; the rest peek out above it.
approval.onDecide: Called with the request's id, the decision, and whether to remember it for next time.
approval.idle: What the dock says when nothing needs you.
approval.autoFocus: Move focus to Approve whenever a new request arrives.
approval.width: The dock's width, say to match a composer it stands in for. Its height never changes.

ask.docs: Every page it can find and cite.
ask.answer: Answers a question, as one string or a stream of text. Close each claim with a doc id in brackets. Abort when the signal does.
ask.search: Finds pages for a query, best first. Defaults to matching words in titles, paths and keywords.
ask.suggested: Ids from `docs` of the pages shown before anything is typed, not questions. Defaults to the first four.
ask.isQuestion: Whether a query is a question worth answering.
ask.onOpen: Called when a page is opened, by click or Enter.
ask.onClose: Called on Escape with nothing typed.
ask.height: The body's fixed height in px, between the field and the keys.
ask.delay: How long typing pauses, in ms, before a question mark asks.

askchart.ask: Answers a question, given the steps so far, so follow-ups can build on them.
askchart.initial: A first question and its answer to start from.

billing.plans: The plans to offer, cheapest first. Defaults to Free, Team and Scale.
billing.current: The id of the plan the workspace is on.
billing.currency: An ISO 4217 code: every price, total and invoice is written in it.
billing.assistant: What the AI is called in the default plans and the usage meter.
billing.onPlanChange: Called once a person confirms a plan change and pays.

bridge.periods: One bridge per period; the switch moves between them.
bridge.title: What's being bridged, above the headline.
bridge.onPoint: Called with the step under the pointer, or null.
bridge.muted: Silence the soft tick as the value catches a step.

buttons.variant: Primary for the one main action, secondary, ghost for quiet ones, danger for destructive ones.
buttons.icon: A square button holding only an icon. Give it an aria-label.
buttons.loading: Show a spinner in place of the label. The button keeps its width.
buttons.done: Shown for a moment in place of the label once the action has finished, e.g. a check.

calendar.product: The product's name beside its mark.
calendar.events: This week's events. Standups and anything else marked weekly show every week.
calendar.people: The people you can ask for time with.
calendar.busy: When those people are busy this week.
calendar.onBook: Called with the event a person books from a suggestion.
calendar.onEventChange: Called with an event a person adds, renames or moves.
calendar.onAsk: Called with what a person asks the assistant.

carousel.slides: The slides, each with a title for the pager.
carousel.autoplay: How long each slide stays, in ms. 0 leaves it to the person.
carousel.label: Names it for screen readers.
carousel.onChange: Called with the slide it moved to.

phrase.parts: The sentence, in order: plain text, a choice ({ id, options }) or a number ({ id, label, min, max, step }).
phrase.value: The current values by id, for a controlled phrase.
phrase.defaultValue: The values it starts with. Without it, each choice starts on its first option and each number on its min.
phrase.onChange: Called with every value whenever one changes.
phrase.says: Writes the line under the sentence from the current values. Leave it out for no line.
phrase.title: The small heading on the card.
phrase.aside: Quiet text at the right of the heading.

chart.format: Formats an amount for the sentence.
chart.label: Names the chart for screen readers.
chart.onStart: Called with the reading a person chose to start from.

checklist.then: The grey line under the count.
checklist.finished: The headline once every step is done.
checklist.finishedAction: A last button, shown once everything's done.
checklist.onFinish: Called when the last step finishes.

chips.suggestions: The prompts to offer, a chip each.
chips.onSend: Called with a chip's prompt when a person sends it.

code.length: How many digits the code has.
code.onVerify: Resolve true when the code is right.
code.onVerified: Called once a code has been accepted.
code.resendAfter: Seconds before a new code can be asked for.
code.onResend: Called when a person asks for a new code.

code-review.assistant: What the agent is called: it opened the pull request and answers in the thread.
code-review.onApply: Called when a person applies the suggested change.
code-review.onMerge: Called when a person merges, once it's approved and every check has passed.

combobox.label: The field's name, read to screen readers.
combobox.creatable: Offer to make what was typed when nothing matches it exactly.

command.onOpenChange: Called when it should open or close: ⌘K, Escape, or a press outside.
command.commands: What can be run, grouped, each with its keys and what it does.
command.inline: Show the menu in place on the page instead of over it.
command.listHeight: The list's height. It's fixed, so filtering never resizes the menu.

confirm.title: The question.
confirm.require: A name to type before the action unlocks, for things that can't be brought back.
confirm.onConfirm: The action. The button spins until it settles.

context.parts: What fills the context window, e.g. the instructions, files and the conversation, in tokens. The last is the one compacting shrinks.
context.onCompact: Called when a person compacts the conversation to make room.
context.warnAt: How full, from 0 to 1, before it's in the redline and suggests compacting.

context-menu.label: Accessible name for the menu.
context-menu.children: The area that has the menu.

cta.product: The product's name, on its line through the queue and in the sentence under the heading.
cta.title: The heading, set in two tones.
cta.note: The small line under the field.
cta.tickets: The tickets in the queue. Each says who, what they asked, and how it ended.
cta.onSubmit: Called with the email a person starts with. Return a promise to keep the button busy until it settles.

data-table.product: The product's name, in the sidebar, the ask bar and the summaries.
data-table.pageSize: Rows on a page. The body is always this many rows tall.
data-table.onOpen: Called with a conversation a person opens.
data-table.onAction: Called when a person runs a bulk action on the selected rows.
data-table.sidebar: Draw the product's sidebar. Turn it off to drop the screen into your own layout.
data-table.onNavigate: Called with a sidebar page a person presses; without it the sidebar is a picture.

dialog.trigger: What opens it. A press on it opens the dialog.
dialog.open: Open or closed, when you control it. Leave out to let the dialog manage itself.
dialog.onOpenChange: Called when it opens or closes.
dialog.title: The heading, read out when it opens.
dialog.icon: Above the heading: an icon tile, a few avatars, a logo.
dialog.hint: A quiet note at the bottom left, e.g. a keyboard shortcut.
dialog.size: Its width: 360, 440 or 560 pixels, never wider than the screen.
dialog.dismissable: Whether a click outside closes it. Escape always does.
dialog.initialFocus: What gets focus when it opens; the first focusable thing otherwise.

diff.title: What the change is, in the header.
diff.hunks: The change, a hunk at a time: where it is, and its lines as context, added or removed.
diff.onApply: Called with each hunk's verdict when a person applies the review.
diff.size: The review's frame; it never changes while you work.
diff.shown: How many lines the agent has written so far, across all hunks. Leave out when complete.

dock.tools: The tools, left to right, each with the panel it opens.
dock.children: The page the dock floats over. It recedes while a panel is open. The dock fills its parent and lays the page in absolutely, so give the parent a height.
dock.recede: Blur and set back the page while a panel is open.
dock.onChange: Called with the open tool's id, or null when the dock closes.

donut.periods: One set of slices per period, oldest first; the switch moves between them.

dotlight.text: The word. Short: it's fitted to the width.
dotlight.line: A tagline under it. It arrives last.
dotlight.tones: The word's own fall, top to bottom, as #rrggbb. Defaults to the family's.
dotlight.dot: The final dot, in css pixels.
dotlight.as: What it is to a screen reader and a search engine.
dotlight.className: Goes on the outer box: a height, a radius.

dropdown.trigger: The button that opens it. It gets the menu's ARIA wiring.
dropdown.items: What's in the menu: items, checks, submenus, separators and labels.
dropdown.label: Accessible name for the menu.
dropdown.side: Which side of the button it prefers.
dropdown.align: How it lines up with the button along that side.

evals.cases: The suite: each case's input, what's expected, and both versions' results.
evals.name: What's being evaluated, in the header.
evals.threshold: The score a case needs to pass, drawn across the chart.
evals.onReview: Called when a person accepts or blocks a regression.
evals.onShip: Called when a person ships the candidate.

extract.label: A small label: what it is and where it came from.
extract.title: The headline, as a two-tone pair: the facts, then the quieter rest.
extract.page: The page as you draw it, and the size it's drawn at; it's scaled to fit.

faq.product: The product's name, wherever the default questions name it.
faq.title: The heading, set in two tones.
faq.questions: The questions. Topics come from them, in the order they first appear.
faq.multiple: Let more than one answer be open at once.
faq.onAsk: Called with what a person searched for when nothing answers it.
faq.onContact: Called when a person asks to talk to someone.
faq.onFeedback: Called when a person says whether an answer helped.

feedback.question: What's asked before anyone rates.
feedback.labels: What each of the five scores is called, lowest first.
feedback.reasons: The reasons offered after a low (1–2), middling (3) or high (4–5) score.
feedback.onSend: Called with the score, the reasons picked and the note, once it's sent.

files.files: The attachments, each with its progress and status. Images with a `preview` show as tiles.
files.onRemove: Called with a file's id when a person removes it.
files.onRetry: Called with a file's id when a person retries a failed upload.
files.empty: What the row says while it's empty.

filter.label: A small label above the bar: what's being filtered.
filter.read: Reads what was typed into clauses. Your model goes here; abort when `signal` fires.
filter.count: How many results a set of filters leaves. Called once per option to give the range while it asks.
filter.total: How many there are with no filters.
filter.readback: The filters said back in plain words, for the line under them.
filter.suggestions: Questions to offer before anything is typed.

find.open: Open from outside, for a phone or a button of your own.
find.shortcut: Take ⌘F while the pointer or focus is inside.

forecast.start: The first month on the chart.
forecast.past: Cash at the end of each month that has happened, oldest first. The last one is now.
forecast.plan: The plan's net change in cash for each month ahead: revenue less spend.
forecast.scenarios: The what-ifs, in the order they were asked.
forecast.recognise: The parts of a what-if your model understands, to light up as it's typed.
forecast.planLabel: What the plan is, shown when there are no what-ifs: "FY27 plan · updated 2 Oct".
forecast.volatility: How much a month's net burn can swing, as a share of the average, for the range.
forecast.defaultView: Start on the line or on the range of likely outcomes.
forecast.onAsk: Called with a what-if in plain words. Report what you're doing with `status`, and stop when `signal` aborts. Resolve with what it means, a question when it could mean more than one thing, or null when it can't be read.
forecast.onAdopt: Called when the what-ifs that are on are held into the plan. Fold them into `plan` and clear them.
forecast.look: `print` (the default) prints the forecast in grain ink; `plain` uses a flat fill.
forecast.suggestions: What-ifs to offer before anything is asked, each in the words your model reads.

funnel.stages: The steps, first to last, with how many people reached each.
funnel.goal: What the last step counts, e.g. "paying customers".
funnel.height: The shape's height in px. Go shorter when most people get through.
funnel.onChange: Called with the rate tried at each step.

halo.children: What sits in the clear middle.
halo.pressToChange: Whether a press melts in the next palette.
halo.className: Classes for the frame. Give it a height, or let its content set one.

histogram.per: Readings per dot. Chosen to fit if left out.
histogram.initialTarget: Where the target pin starts. Defaults to the 95th percentile.
histogram.noun: What a reading is, for the headline.

hold.onNote: Called with each voice note once it's released: how long, and its waveform.
hold.onCancel: Called when a recording is thrown away.
hold.placeholder: What the bar says when it isn't recording.
hold.cancelAt: How far left, in pixels, a recording has to be slid before letting go throws it away.

hovercard.trigger: The link or name it previews.
hovercard.children: What's in the card, when it's already known.
hovercard.load: Fetches what's in the card the first time it opens. A placeholder shows until it settles.
hovercard.side: Which side of the link it prefers.
hovercard.align: How it lines up with the link.
hovercard.openDelay: How long the pointer has to rest before it opens, in ms. Inside a group, only the first card waits.
hovercard.closeDelay: How long it lingers after the pointer leaves, in ms.
hovercard.label: Accessible name for the card.

images.images: Every image it can find, with what a vision model sees in each.
images.search: Scores every image for a query, and an image to find more like. May answer later, from a server.
images.onOpen: Called when an image is opened, by click or Enter.
images.onQuery: Called with the query and the image to find more like, whenever either changes.
images.onSeeAll: Called from the foot to see every match, not just the best nine. Without it, the link is hidden.

inbox.onRead: Called with an item's id when it's opened or marked read.
inbox.onReadAll: Called when a person marks everything read.
inbox.onDismiss: Called with an item's id when it's swiped or closed away.
inbox.onInvite: Called with an invite's id and whether it was accepted.
inbox.align: Which edge of the bell the inbox lines up with.

integrations.product: The product's name, in the line under the glass and on the panel.
integrations.title: The heading, set in two tones.
integrations.integrations: The tools, dealt across three rows in turn. Eighteen to thirty sit best.
integrations.speed: How fast the rows drift, in pixels a second.
integrations.onConnect: Called when a person presses Connect. Return a promise to keep it busy until it settles.

lens.data: The points, oldest first. Give them a `group` to compare like with like.
lens.label: Names the chart for screen readers.
lens.onRead: Called with the point being read.

live-features.product: The product's name, in the eyebrow and wherever the tiles name it.
live-features.eyebrow: The small line above the heading.
live-features.title: The heading: the claim, then its turn, set in two tones.
live-features.features: The words on the five tiles, in order. The tiles' live parts stay as they are.

metric.metric: The metric shown, if you control it.
metric.defaultMetric: The metric shown first, if you don't.
metric.period: What the numbers cover, at the top right, e.g. "October · as of Oct 28".
metric.width: Its width. The height never changes as metrics switch.
metric.footer: Quiet actions under the basis line, e.g. "Show the AWS lines".
metric.highlight: A driver to point at from outside, by name, as a person pointing would. A scripted demo uses it.

models.value: The model and effort in use.
models.efforts: The effort levels, with what each does to time and cost.
models.lift: How far above the trigger the menu sits, in px, to clear a composer.
models.muted: Silence the soft tick effort makes as it catches a notch.

onboarding.assistant: What the first agent is called.
onboarding.workspace: The workspace being set up, named in the preview.
onboarding.tools: The tools on offer, each with the account it connects to.
onboarding.teammates: People suggested for an invite, e.g. from the GitHub org.
onboarding.onConnect: Called with a tool's id when a person connects it.
onboarding.onInvite: Called with the addresses a person invites.
onboarding.onComplete: Called when setup finishes, with what was connected, who was invited and the agent created.

photobar.onChange: Called when the look or its strength changes.
photobar.className: Classes for the frame. Give it a height.

popover.trigger: The button that opens it. It gets the popover's ARIA wiring.
popover.side: Which side of the button it prefers.
popover.align: How it lines up with the button along that side.
popover.arrow: Draw the arrow that points at the button.
popover.label: Accessible name for the panel.
popover.className: Classes for the panel: its width and padding, say.

popup.options: The choices. Made for short lists: everything shows at once, with no scrolling.
popup.value: The chosen option, for a controlled popup.
popup.label: What it chooses, for screen readers.
popup.name: Set to submit the value with a form.
popup.radius: Corner radius of the closed pill, for one sitting inside something round.
popup.textClass: Type for the pill and the menu, for one sitting beside other text.

presence.people: Who's here, each with a colour, a status and what they're doing.
presence.max: How many faces show before the rest become a count.
presence.following: The id of the person being followed, or null.
presence.onFollow: Called with a person's id to follow them, or null to stop.
presence.open: Hold the stack open, e.g. while a demo shows it off.

pricing.title: The line above the sentence: the model, then what it isn't, set in two tones.
pricing.unit: What you charge for, e.g. "conversations", "seats" or "credits".
pricing.range: The lowest and highest the number can go.
pricing.words: The sentence, around its number, plan and price. Built from `unit` and `period` if left out.
pricing.tone: Follow the page's theme, or stay black whatever it is.
pricing.hint: Helps a person find their number.
pricing.plans: The plans, cheapest first. Each prices itself from its base, what it includes and what it charges after.
pricing.compare: Rows of the full comparison, one value per plan.
pricing.answers: The questions people ask before they buy.
pricing.conversations: Where the number starts, in conversations a month.
pricing.discount: Taken off the base price when billed yearly.
pricing.onSelect: Called with the plan a person picks, the billing and the volume they set.
pricing.onContact: Called when a person asks to talk about a plan past the top of the range.

prompt.onSend: Return a promise to show the working state until it settles; if it rejects, the words come back to the box.
prompt.onStop: Called when a person stops what's working.
prompt.placeholder: Shown while the box is empty.
prompt.hint: The rest of the placeholder: "or drop a file to start from it."
prompt.label: A quiet line over the words, e.g. "New chat".
prompt.initialMode: The id of the mode it starts in.
prompt.initialFiles: Files already attached when it opens.
prompt.suggestions: Prompts to offer; the focused, empty box shows the first, and Tab takes it.
prompt.width: The box's width. It grows in height only, as far as its own scroll.
prompt.busy: Whether an answer is coming, when you track that yourself. Leave it out and the box follows the promise `onSend` returns.
prompt.status: What it's doing while it answers: "Reading the board update". Only ever what you say.
prompt.model: The model, named beside Send. With `models`, the one it starts on.
prompt.models: Models to choose between, each with your own icon. Without them `model` is plain text, with no chevron pretending to be a menu.
prompt.onModel: Called when a person picks a model.
prompt.projects: Projects to file this under. Given, a slim strip under the field offers them.
prompt.onProject: Called when a person picks a project, or null for none.
prompt.onVoice: Shows a microphone key; called when it's pressed.
prompt.onGrow: Called as the box grows above its resting height, with how far, so whatever sits above it can make room.

radar.axes: The qualities, clockwise from the top.
radar.series: The things that can be compared, each with a value from 0 to 1 per axis.
radar.initialPair: The two compared first. Defaults to the first two series.
radar.format: How a value or a margin is written.

readalong.lines: What's said, and when each sentence starts.
readalong.from: Who it's from, and what about.

region.regions: The regions to choose from, ordered west to east so the Earth spins one way as you turn.
region.from: Where your visitor is. Left out, a rough guess is made from their clock's time zone.
region.latency: Round-trip time to a region in ms. Pass your own measurements; the default estimates from distance.
region.onChange: Called with the region it settles on.
region.passOver: For a drum sitting in a page people are scrolling. A wheel or a quick swipe passes over it to the page; tap above or below the middle to step it, rest a finger a moment and drag to spin it, and once a mouse has clicked it the wheel turns it.

rename.onRename: Return a promise to show saving; reject it to roll back.
rename.validate: Return a message to block the name, or null to allow it.
rename.keepExtension: Edit the name but not its extension: the selection stops at the dot.
rename.activate: Start editing on one click or on a double click.
rename.label: What's being renamed, for screen readers.
rename.className: Added to the name as it's shown.

retry.attempt: Tries again. Resolve true if it worked; false waits longer and tries again.
retry.base: Seconds before the first retry. Each failure doubles it.
retry.title: What went wrong, in a few words.

reveal.shots: The images to reveal, each with its prompt and the point focus spreads from, as 0 to 1 across and down.

rewind.history: A tape saved from `onHistory`, so rewinding survives a reload.
rewind.onHistory: Called after each edit with the whole tape, ready to store.
rewind.pill: Show the pill. Off, ⌘Z and the wheel still rewind.
rewind.lost: The colour deleted words come back in.
rewind.ghost: How faint text you haven't written yet is, 0 to 1.
rewind.intro: Plays itself once when first seen: runs back to this step, holds, and comes home. For demos. A touch ends it.
rewind.maxHeight: Taller than this and it scrolls.

rewrite.rewrite: Writes the new version of the selected words, from a quick ask or your own words. Resolve with the replacement.
rewrite.actions: The quick asks the bar offers beside the field.
rewrite.assistant: What the assistant is called while it works.
rewrite.onChange: Called with the whole paragraph after a change is accepted.

rings.days: How many days the period has.
rings.today: Which day is today, counting from 0. The scrubber stops here.
rings.dayLabel: How to name a day on the scrubber, e.g. (d) => `Oct ${d + 1}`.
rings.onDayChange: Called with the day being read, or null when it's back on today.
rings.onOver: Called with the goals past their wall, the moment one breaks through or falls back.
rings.muted: Silence the soft click as a bar breaks through.

run.step: What it's doing now, in a few words.
run.index: Which step it's on, from 1, and how many there are.
run.onRun: Called when a person starts the run.
run.onStop: Called when a person stops it.
run.onResume: Called when a person resumes a stopped run.
run.label: The button's words before it runs.

scaffold.name: The project's name. The command and the tree's root use it.
scaffold.files: Every path the command creates, in the order it prints them. The tree is sized for all of them before the first arrives.
scaffold.icons: An icon per path, for files that deserve their own mark.
scaffold.command: What types itself at the prompt.

scatter.noun: What a point is, for the headline: "requests".
scatter.onSelect: Called with the ids inside the lasso, or null when it's cleared.

secret.name: What the key is for.
secret.scope: A short note on the right, like its access level.
secret.used: The quiet line under it, like when it was last used.
secret.lead: Characters always shown at the start.
secret.tail: Characters always shown at the end.
secret.onCopy: Called after the key is copied.

select.value: The chosen option's value, or null for none.
select.onChange: Called with an option's value when a person picks it.
select.options: What to choose from: a label, and an optional icon, hint or disabled flag.
select.label: Accessible name for the control.

settings.workspace: The workspace's name, in the danger zone.
settings.assistant: What the AI is called: the keys call it.
settings.onCreateKey: Called with a key once a person creates it. The secret itself never leaves the dialog.
settings.onRotateKey: Called with a key's id when a person rotates it.
settings.onInvite: Called with the address a person invites.
settings.onDeleteWorkspace: Called when a person holds to delete the workspace, and with false if they undo it.

sidebar.brand: The product's mark and name, at the top.
sidebar.footer: Anything for the bottom: the signed-in person, say. It's given the rail state, to fit either.
sidebar.min: The narrowest it goes before folding to a rail.

sign-in.product: The product being signed in to: the heading, the mark's label, the email and the consent sheet.
sign-in.providers: Which one-press providers to offer, in order. Email is always there.
sign-in.workspaces: The workspaces to choose from once you're signed in.
sign-in.waiting: What's waiting on the other side, beside the form and redacted until a person is in. An empty list gives the form the whole window.
sign-in.onComplete: Called with the workspace a person picks.

signature.onSign: Called once it's sealed, with the name and when.
signature.title: What's being signed, in fine capitals at the top.
signature.reference: A reference beside the title, e.g. "Nº 0482".
signature.detail: A line saying what the signature agrees to.
signature.fontFamily: The script it signs in, as a CSS font family. Load the font yourself.
signature.size: The signature's size at its largest, in px. Long names shrink to fit the line.
signature.pen: Show the pencil that writes it.

slices.text: The words. One line works best.
slices.strips: How many strips it's cut into.
slices.fill: Any CSS background for the letters. Leave it out to use the text colour.
slices.reach: How far the strips part under the pointer, in pixels.
slices.interactive: Whether it cuts apart under the pointer.
slices.className: Classes for the text: its size, weight and tracking.

stepper.onChange: Called with the next number, by a press, a hold or typing.
stepper.step: How much each press changes it.
stepper.label: What's being counted, for screen readers.

support-inbox.assistant: What the assistant is called: it sorts, drafts and signs its suggestions.
support-inbox.product: The product's name at the top of the views.
support-inbox.conversations: The conversations to work through, newest first.
support-inbox.onSend: Called with the conversation and the reply a person sends.
support-inbox.onDone: Called when a person marks a conversation done without replying.

tabs.tabs: Each tab's id, its label, and what it shows.
tabs.defaultTab: The id of the tab that's open first.
tabs.onChange: Called with a tab's id when a person opens it.
tabs.id: Keeps the sliding indicator to this set of tabs when there are several on a page.

tags.label: The field's name, shown above it and read to screen readers.
tags.suggestions: Offered under the field as you type; Tab or Enter takes the highlighted one.
tags.max: The most tags it holds. Past it, new ones are refused.
tags.placeholder: Shown in the field while it's empty.
tags.onChange: Called with the whole list whenever a tag is added or removed.

task-to-merge.assistant: What the agent is called in its steps, messages and the composer.
task-to-merge.onDecide: Called when a person approves or denies the deploy.
task-to-merge.onMerge: Called when a person merges the pull request.
task-to-merge.onSteer: Called with each message a person sends to steer the run.

testimonials.product: The product's name, on the after side of each number and in the default quotes.
testimonials.title: The heading, set in two tones.
testimonials.stories: The featured customers, in turn. In a quote, {braces} mark the phrase to highlight.
testimonials.quotes: The wall of short quotes under them.

thinking.steps: What it's thought so far, a line each. The newest shows on the line; its first word picks the pattern.
thinking.done: Thinking has finished: the line settles into how long it took.
thinking.expanded: Open the steps from outside, e.g. in a demo.

threads.title: The headline.
threads.sentLabel: What the button says once pressed. Left out, it keeps its label.
threads.onAction: Called when the button is pressed.
threads.className: Classes for the section. It fills its parent, so give it a height here or there.

glyph.shape: What to draw: `{ path }` for a 24×24 SVG icon path, with optional `view` and `scale`, or `{ text }` for a word, with optional `weight`. Change it and the characters re-form.
glyph.cell: Character size in pixels. Left out, it sizes itself to the space.
glyph.ink: Colour of the characters. Left out, it uses your text colour.
glyph.accent: Colour where the pointer and ripples light it up. Left out, it uses `--accent`.
glyph.interactive: Set to false for a still, decorative version that ignores the pointer.
glyph.label: What it shows, for screen readers. Left out, it's hidden from them as decoration.
glyph.className: Classes for the canvas. It fills its parent, so size the parent.

toasts.events: What the agent did or is doing, newest last.
toasts.agent: Who's working: the name seeds their orb and the hue colours it, unless you give an avatar of your own, 30px round.
toasts.onAction: Called with an event's id when a person presses its action.
toasts.onDismiss: Called with an event's id when it's closed.
toasts.max: How many show in the stack before older ones tuck behind.
toasts.expanded: Hold the stack open, e.g. while a demo shows it off.

tooltip.label: What the control does, in a word or two.
tooltip.shortcut: Its keyboard shortcut, one key per entry, like ['⌘', 'B'].
tooltip.side: Which side it prefers. It flips when there's no room.
tooltip.children: The control. It gets `aria-describedby` while the tooltip shows.

trace.title: What the run is doing, in the header.
trace.runId: The run's id, shown beside the title.
trace.spans: Every agent, model and tool call, with when each was busy and how it went.
trace.endedAt: performance.now() when the run finished. Leave it out while it's running.
trace.status: How the run stands: running, waiting on a person, done or failed.
trace.rows: How many steps show before the rest scroll.
trace.flush: Fill its container as a pane, with no card around it.
trace.nameWidth: The least width of the step column, in px.
trace.view: Plain sentences for the people the agent works for, or step names for the people who built it.
trace.waitingLabel: What the time spent on a person is called.
trace.onApprove: Called with a span's id when a person approves the step it's waiting on.
trace.onDeny: Called with a span's id when a person denies it.

tree.nodes: The folders and files. A node with children is a folder.
tree.defaultOpen: Paths of the folders open at first.
tree.selected: The selected path, to control it from outside. Leave it out and the tree keeps its own.
tree.onSelect: Called with a file's path when a person opens it.
tree.label: The tree's accessible name.

trend.forecast: What might, nearest first, as a low and a high for each day.
trend.format: Formats an amount for the sentence.
trend.unit: Follows the range, e.g. "tokens a day".
trend.today: Labels the point where the data stops.
trend.odds: Turns how far ahead it is, from 0 to 1, into words.
trend.look: Grain ink, or a flat fill.
trend.onRead: Called with the day ahead being read.

typing.lines: The conversation, oldest first. A line marked typing shows the dots until its text arrives.
typing.agent: Who's answering: their name, for screen readers, and the hue of their orb, or an avatar of your own, 28px round.
typing.readAt: When your last message was read, shown beside Read, e.g. "9:41".

undo.title: The list's heading.
undo.seconds: How long a deleted batch can be undone. Every new delete restarts it.
undo.onDelete: Called once the undo window closes, with every file deleted in that batch. Delete them for real here.
undo.onUndo: Called with the files put back by Undo or ⌘Z.

upload.accept: What it takes, in words, under the drop zone.
upload.onFiles: Called with the files a person drops or picks. Start the real upload here.

versions.initial: The versions so far, oldest first. The newest is shown.
versions.generate: Makes version n. Resolve with its text; the shimmer holds the reply's place until then.

video.title: Named in the top corner while the controls show, and to screen readers.
video.chapters: Where each chapter starts, in seconds. The timeline is cut at each one.
video.captions: A WebVTT file's URL, or the cues themselves.
video.storyboard: Thumbnails for the timeline's preview. Without them it shows the chapter and time alone.

voice.level: Loudness, 0 to 1, from the microphone (or anything else).
voice.text: The committed text: anything typed plus words recognition is sure of.
voice.interim: Words heard but not yet committed.
voice.onTextChange: Called as the text changes, by typing or by speech.
voice.onStart: Called when a person starts listening. Start recognition here.
voice.onStop: Called when listening should stop, by a press or by quiet.
voice.onCancel: Called when a person throws the recording away.
voice.onSend: Called with the text a person sends.
voice.autoStop: Stop on its own after this much quiet.
voice.placeholder: Shown while the field is empty.

voice-mode.assistant: What the assistant is called: on the captions, the status and the controls.
voice-mode.call: The call to play: what each side says, where the person interrupts, what lights up and what changes.
voice-mode.days: The days shown beside the call, each with its events.
voice-mode.onEnd: Called when the call ends, with how long it ran and what was changed during it.
voice-mode.onUndo: Called with an action a person undoes.

voicenote.words: The transcript, word by word, with when each is said.
voicenote.duration: How long the note is, in seconds.
voicenote.src: The audio itself. Leave it out to play on a clock.
voicenote.peaks: Loudness, 0 to 1, across the note. Worked out from the words' timing when left out.

waitlist.joined: How many people are already waiting. The count rolls up to it, plus one, when someone joins.
waitlist.onJoin: Called with the email. Return a promise to keep the button busy until it settles.
waitlist.placeholder: Shown in the field while it's empty.
waitlist.done: The line under the field once someone's in.

hello.initial: The locale code it opens on, like `hi-IN`.
hello.locales: The languages to offer: each has a code, its name in its own language and in English, the country, a greeting, and a point on the map. Left out, it uses the 37 it ships with.
hello.auto: Open on the visitor's browser language when it's in the list.
hello.onChange: Called with the locale a person picks.

emoji.draft: The text the message opens with.
emoji.onPick: Called with each emoji or symbol a person adds.
emoji.onSend: Called with the message text when Send is pressed; the field then clears.

agent-canvas.agents: The agents to offer, in order. Use the built-in `claude`, `chatgpt` and `grok`, or pass your own as `{ id, name, mark, placeholder }` to add Gemini, Perplexity or your own bot. One agent hides the switcher.
agent-canvas.agent: The `id` of the agent it opens in. Ignored unless it's in `agents`; defaults to the first.
agent-canvas.product: Your product's name, shown as "Claude × Relay".
agent-canvas.productMark: Your product's mark, drawn in white on black in the header. Card avatars come from `respond`.
agent-canvas.prompt: The request it plays on load. Switching agents replays the latest request, including one a person typed.
agent-canvas.respond: Turns a request into what happens: the chat `steps`, the canvas `title`, `subtitle` and `stat`, the `cards` that write themselves (title, body with **bold** and @mentions, chips), the `ask`, the `confirm` labels and the `reply`. It gets the chosen agent too, so it can route on `agent.id` to Claude, OpenAI, xAI or your own model, and it can be async. Mark a step `writes` to write the canvas during it and `counts` to roll the stat. Defaults to `relayPlan`, the Linear and Slack demo.
agent-canvas.autoplay: Play `prompt` on load. Set it to false to start empty and wait for someone to type.
agent-canvas.onEnable: Called with the plan and the request when someone confirms.
agent-canvas.onDraft: Called with the plan and the request when someone declines.

shift.title: The card's name, shown in its header.
shift.items: The sources: each has an id, a label, a value, an optional delta (percent change) and an icon.
shift.period: What the total covers, shown beside it, like "Last 30 days".
shift.unit: What is being counted, used in the headline and empty state.
shift.delta: The total's change, shown beside the headline.
shift.limit: How many sources to show before the rest fold into one row.
shift.view: The view to show: list, bars or change. Pair with onViewChange.
shift.defaultView: The view to start on when you don't control it.
shift.onViewChange: Called with the view a person switches to.
shift.format: Turns a number into the text shown for it.

livelist.title: The list's name, shown in its header.
livelist.people: Everyone on the list: an id, a name and a hue for their colour.
livelist.groups: The groups items are filed under: an id, a label and a hue.
livelist.items: The items, when you control the list. Pair with onItemsChange.
livelist.defaultItems: The items to start with when the list keeps its own state.
livelist.onItemsChange: Called with the whole list after any add or tick.
livelist.me: The id of the person using it; their items are added under this id.
livelist.height: The height of the scrolling body in pixels. The card never grows past it.

mcp.name: Your server's name, shown in the title and configs.
mcp.slug: The key your server is saved under in each editor's config.
mcp.icon: Your logo, shown in the dark tile.
mcp.description: One line on what the server gives access to.
mcp.clients: The editors to offer: an id, a label, an icon and an optional tint for the copy glow.
mcp.tools: How many tools the server exposes, shown once connected.
mcp.client: The editor to show, when you control it. Pair with onClientChange.
mcp.defaultClient: The editor to start on when you don't control it.
mcp.onClientChange: Called with the editor a person picks.
mcp.status: idle, waiting or connected. Drive it from your server; left out, copying sets waiting.
mcp.onCopy: Called with the editor when the config is copied or Add to Cursor is pressed.
mcp.auth: How the remote server signs in, shown in the header.
mcp.pkg: Your npm package. Set it to offer a Local option that runs it with npx.
mcp.envVar: The environment variable the local server reads its key from.
mcp.apiKey: A key to put in the local config.
mcp.onCreateKey: Makes a key when "Create one" is pressed; return it and it lands in the config.
mcp.defaultScope: Start on this project or everywhere.
